intro.text: The quiet fourth member of a team of Institute of Mechanical Solutions scholars in Gongsha, who volunteers to prime their failing machine.
One of the Torish scholars of the Institute of Mechanical Solutions who switched on the father machine, which keeps Yumi prisoner.

items.text: He was one of the scholars who designed and switched on the father machine. It consumed him but held his soul in reserve to defend itself, though he still became a nightmare. When Yumi's mind began resisting the machine, he was among the four scholars Gyundok led to Gongsha Town to investigate.

When their prototype would not run and the others refused to prime it with their own essence, he stepped out of the shadows of the tent and offered. As he charged it, Yumi came close and unknowingly helped, and he was relieved to come through unharmed.
He stayed with the others to contain Yumi after she and Nikaro were separated. When she escaped, he joined the chase to Torio City, where her will forced him to stand down.

appearance.text: He shares the other scholars' beard and mustache, though his mustache falls short of theirs, and he dresses in white with a black, winged tanggeon.

personality.text: He is quieter and more withdrawn than his colleagues.
